lesson: R3 (final): inclusion is SATURATED — 20 synthetics gave inclusion AP50 0.407, better than 25 (0.355-0.376), so stop feeding inclusion and shift budget to patches/scratches; the winning final model is 20/20/10 (mAP50 0.6367). prefer_small for inclusion is NOT a reliable lever (flat 0.355-0.407, noisy), while prefer_small clearly helped patches (0.772) and roughly matched uniform for scratches (0.741 vs 0.758) — the small-source lever is class-specific and weak, so allocation balance is the dominant lever. If more rounds existed: hold inclusion ~20, push patches/scratches, and re-test prefer_small on patches only.
